hero.title: Nouriddin Ben Zekri
hero.lead: I build the systems companies depend on: gas distribution for energy suppliers, credit rating in banking, port logistics. Java and Spring on the back, React on the front. AI is part of how I code every day, and it powers the products I build on the side.

projects.heading: Things I build
projects.intro: Outside client work I design, build and run my own products, end to end: product, code, infrastructure and the marketing that follows.

beyond.heading: Beyond code
beyond.text: When I am not shipping code you will find me on the road, from the Icelandic highlands to the Moroccan Atlas, camera in hand. Travel keeps me curious, and curiosity is half the job.
